# Jacob Qumsiyeh

> Freelance full stack developer building Shopify storefronts, SaaS landing pages, and high-performance web applications for e-commerce store owners and SaaS founders.

Jacob Qumsiyeh is a full stack developer based in Beit Sahour, Palestine, working with clients worldwide. He specializes in two niches: e-commerce (Shopify storefronts, WooCommerce) and SaaS/startup founders (landing pages, MVPs). Stack: React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, WordPress/WooCommerce, TailwindCSS.

## Services

- Shopify Starter Storefront: theme setup, product loading, essential app configuration. $900-1,800, 5-7 day delivery.
- Landing Page Sprint: a single high-converting landing page for a launch, product, or waitlist. $600-1,200, 3-5 day delivery.
- Personal Site in a Week: a single-page portfolio site. $300-600, 2-3 day delivery.

- [SanctiShell case study](https://jacobqum.dev/case-study-sanctishell.html): self-hosted WooCommerce store for a family Mother-of-Pearl artisan business in Bethlehem.
